definitions.short: Shear-Jashub , the symbolic name of one of Isaiah's sons
definitions.full: H7610. Shear Yashub יָשׁוּב שְׁאָר proper name, masculine of Isaiah's son Isa 7:3 ( = a remnant shall return , compare 10:21 ; ᵐ5 ὁ καταλειφθείς Ἰασουβ ).
definitions.rootNote: from 7605 and 7725 ; a remnant will return ;

occurrences.englishText: Then Yahweh said to Isaiah, “Go out now to meet Ahaz, you, and Shearjashub your son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool, on the highway of the fuller’s field.
